story: Meet the White Tailed Sea Eagle (Haliaeetus albicilla), a distinctive bird from the Accipitridae family. Preferring habitats such as Sea coasts; lake shores; rivers; islands; wetlands; and estuaries, this species has adapted to thrive under specific environmental conditions. With an IUCN status of Least Concern (LC), its population trends are closely watched by scientists and enthusiasts. The White Tailed Sea Eagle serves as an indicator species for the health of its environment. Whether you are a seasoned ornithologist or a curious nature lover, learning about the White Tailed Sea Eagle enriches our understanding of nature.
